U's daughter, X, is the daughter-in-law of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6476c7180f1fb7bac52ba7b716d194ee6f21dee0de2afd8512d265b45906e2c9.png] 

W is the nephew of X.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Radhika said - "His son's mother is the sister of my son's sister." How is the person related to Radhika?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

• Radhika points at a man and says that his son's mother is the sister of Radhika's son's sister. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b669cd2dae1896e1793ef2daee765d5fb00b47ca7e038e36bd442e4470b0a30.png]
